Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
The loyalty service shall show all members their points history in the customer mobile app.
Rationale: Members ask support for their history (S-03).

Text: The loyalty service shall award bonus points quickly.
The customer mobile app shall display the points balance quickly after login.
Rationale: Members check the balance right after paying.

Text: The voucher code shall be validated before the POS applies the discount.
The loyalty service will send the member a push notification when points are posted.
IF the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, the loyalty service shall keep the points of that purchase pending.
Rationale: Fraudulent points must not be redeemed before review.

Text: The loyalty service shall export the daily points extract and email the finance controller.
Rationale: Finance reconciles the points liability every morning.

Text: WHEN a member with at least 500 posted points requests a voucher, the loyalty service shall issue a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 points.
Rationale: Redemption rule from the programme terms.

Text: IF a member requests a voucher with fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request.
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: The admin console shall support the handling of points adjustments by support agents.
Rationale: Support resolves complaints about missing points.

Text: WHEN a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, the admin console shall require approval by a second support agent before posting it.
WHEN the loyalty service posts points, the customer mobile app shall show the new balance within TBD seconds.
Rationale: Members check the app right after paying.

Text: The loyalty service shall reverse the points of a returned purchase.
